title: Hermes
subtitle: hermes-agent (OSS) + Langfuse + HITL
description: Nous Research's hermes-agent is the open-source harness (MIT-licensed) — what's here is what I built around it: a nightly Langfuse eval loop and a weekly self-improvement cron that clusters its own low-quality turns and proposes fixes to its own prompt, running on a 3-node homelab with a hand-patched local inference layer. One real run: 11 low-quality turns, 3 proposed fixes, 2 applied, 1 correctly rejected as wrong for the context — nothing changes without my approval.

title: Pi-Cloud
subtitle: Private Infrastructure + Service Operations
description: A Raspberry Pi 5 that runs the private services I rely on for photos, passwords, documents, DNS filtering, remote access, monitoring, and recovery. The interesting work is operating it deliberately: clear service boundaries, no public ports, health checks, and backups that can be restored when something fails.

title: Inference Engine
subtitle: llama.cpp + ROCm + Local Agentic Workflows
description: The engine behind every local agentic workflow I run, reachable from my phone over Telegram, with every call traced and nightly graded by its own eval loop. A hand-patched llama.cpp build on GPU hardware the project doesn't officially support: fixed a memory-allocator bug that was capping GPU offload, and traced a week-long regression through a wrong first diagnosis to a one-line bug in my own code, not the dependency everyone assumed was at fault.

title: Job-Fit Scorer
subtitle: LangGraph + FastAPI + Langfuse
description: A LangGraph pipeline that polls 13 companies' ATS boards directly, reduces thousands of raw postings to a shortlist of relevant roles, and scores each one against my actual portfolio with a parallel fan-out of requirement-level evaluations — deliberately calibrated to be honest rather than flattering. Every run is traced end-to-end in Langfuse, and results land in a durable, append-only tracker.

title: AI Chat Assistant
subtitle: Gemini 2.5 Flash + Cloudflare Workers + Structured Context
description: The assistant in the corner of this page. A Cloudflare Worker gives Gemini a compact, structured reference for the whole portfolio on every request—no vector database or unnecessary retrieval layer. The model can also return action markers that become real UI buttons, such as opening the resume or jumping to a section.

title: myPal
subtitle: Rapid Prototyping Case Study for Assistive Tech
description: An AAC (Augmentative and Alternative Communication) tool designed for rapid deployment in low-resource environments. Architected with an offline-first SQLite schema for reliable data persistence without network dependency, paired with React Native cross-platform synchronization to enable seamless iOS/Android parity. Focused on assistive tech accessibility for children with autism and speech delays, demonstrating how technical constraints (limited connectivity, diverse devices) can drive scalable architectural decisions.
